summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # **Petition No. 69/MP/2018** **Coram: Shri P.K.Pujari, Chairperson Shri A.K.Singhal, Member Dr. M.K.Iyer, Member** **Date of Order: 30** **th** **of August, 2018** # **In the matter of** Petition for up-gradation of the inter-State trading licence from Category-IV to Category-II. # **And In the matter of** Amplus Energy Solutions Private Limited 6 th Floor, Emaar Palm Squarem Golf Course Extension Road, Sector -66, Gurgaon, Haryana-122 102 **Petitioner** # **Parties present:** Shri Anil Bhatt, Amplus Energy # ** ORDER ** The Petitioner, Amplus Energy Solutions Private Limited, has filed the present petition for up-gradation of its inter-State trading licence in electricity from Category IV to Category I. 2. During the course of hearing, the representative of the Petitioner sought permission to withdraw the present petition with liberty to the Petitioner to approach the Commission after satisfying the required current ratio and liquidity **Order in Petition No. 69/MP/2018** **1** ratio. The representative of the Petitioner requested to adjust the filing fee against the petition to be filed with all necessary information. 3. The prayer of the Petitioner is allowed. Accordingly, Petition No. 69/MP/2018 is disposed of as withdrawn. However, the request for adjustment of fee is rejected. Sd/sd/sd/- **(Dr. M.K.Iyer) (A. K. Singhal) (P.K.Pujari) Member Member Chairperson** **Order in Petition No. 69/MP/2018** **2**
title: Petition for up-gradation of the inter-State trading licence from Category-IV to Category-II. Amplus Energy Solutions Private Limited
